observations: Industrial sewing machine mounted on a specialized table stand.
The brand 'SUMO Premium' is printed on the machine arm in photo 0.
A blue identification plate is visible on the machine head, but the text is illegible.
A power switch with green and red buttons is attached to the right side of the table.
The machine is plugged into a wall socket via a black power cord.
A thread stand with spools is visible behind the machine.
The table surface shows a printed ruler scale.
General signs of use, including dust and minor surface wear on the table and machine body.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine powered on and sewing through fabric to verify mechanical and motor condition.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out, seized, or excessively noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine running.

risks.risk: Internal timing issues or damaged needle bar causing skipped stitches.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a sample line on fabric.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal components (e.g., bobbin case, gears).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bobbin area and a video of the handwheel turning smoothly.

proof_requests: A clear, close-up photo of the blue model identification plate on the machine head.
A video of the machine being turned on and sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate the motor and stitch quality.
A photo of the motor located under the table.
response.reason: The brand is identified as SUMO Premium, but the specific model number on the blue plate is unreadable. Industrial sewing machines vary significantly in value based on their specific model and features.
